objectives.label: Clear the bandits from the road {direction} of {settlement}

title: The road {direction}
Clear the road
summary: The guard captain wants the road {direction} of {settlement} cleared of bandits.
offer: Quiet in town, thank the gods, but the road {direction} of here is another matter. There is a band of cutthroats camped {distance} out. Clear them.
complete: The road is safe again. Good work.
